entries.zh: 征讨；征伐（出兵讨伐）
entries.en: to conquer / subdue by military campaign (L column likely reads moros, i.e. to war on the Moors)
entries.notes: L 栏 miros 疑为 moros（摩尔人）之讹；两读音栏与「討」字对音不完全吻合，主义「征讨」以汉栏为准

entries.zh: 征伐吞并；吞并（他国、邦土）
entries.en: to conquer and annex (a kingdom); to conquer by swallowing up

entries.zh: 吞并；兼并（土地、邦国）
entries.en: to swallow up / annex (a kingdom, territory)

entries.zh: 占；占据、侵占（城邑土地）；（另读）占卜
entries.en: to occupy / seize (land, a kingdom); (variant reading) to divine

entries.zh: 谏诤；临终劝诫（遗训）〔原件污损、对音不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: admonition / counsel at the hour of death (deathbed exhortation) [text partly smudged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: M 栏标注污损难辨（T99），且两读音栏均与「諫」字对音不合，主义据西语「临终劝诫」与汉栏暂定

entries.zh: 兵部；掌全国军政之衙门（相当于战事会议）
entries.en: Board / Ministry of War (the war council)
entries.notes: M 栏另附一别名读音，其对应汉字不明，不影响主释义

entries.zh: 刑部；掌刑狱司法之衙门
entries.en: Board / Ministry of Justice (criminal justice, punishments)

entries.zh: 工部；掌营造百工、修缮工程之衙门
entries.en: Board / Ministry of Works (public works and repairs)

entries.zh: 吏部；掌官员铨选任免之衙门
entries.en: Board / Ministry of Personnel (civil offices and appointments)

entries.zh: 户部；掌财赋、户籍之衙门
entries.en: Board / Ministry of Revenue (rents, taxes, households)

entries.zh: 礼部；掌礼仪文教之衙门
entries.en: Board / Ministry of Rites (ceremonies, education)

entries.zh: 宰相；丞相（辅佐皇帝的最高大臣）
entries.en: grand chancellor / chief counselor of the emperor

entries.zh: 相议；商议、共同计议
entries.en: to deliberate / consult together; counsel

entries.zh: 谗言；谗害之言（附和恶事而宣扬之）
entries.en: slander / calumny; consenting to evil and spreading it
entries.notes: L 栏文句有讹且句末截断（aullar 疑为言说动词之误写），主义依汉栏「谗言」

entries.zh: 存；保存、留存；亦指存在
entries.en: to preserve / keep; to exist, remain
entries.notes: M 栏多出一音节，疑为「在」而构成「存在」义，不碍主释义

entries.zh: 膏；浓膏、膏剂（蜜饯膏方一类）
entries.en: thick conserve / confection paste (syrup; medicament)

entries.zh: 餹；糖渍甜食、蜜饯（罕用字，或近「餞」）
entries.en: sweetmeat / sugar-preserved confection
entries.notes: 「餹」为罕字，两读音栏与今「糖」音不合而近「餞」，据本页蜜饯类语境定义

entries.zh: 蜜、茶与配料（调制蜜饯、茶饮之材料）
entries.en: honey, tea, and aromatic ingredients (materials for preserves / tea drinks)
entries.notes: 三字并列，具体所指（蜜茶调制的蜜饯或茶料）难以确证

entries.zh: 蜜餹；蜜餞，以蜜糖渍制之果品
entries.en: candied preserves / fruit conserved in honey-sugar
entries.notes: 「餹」字与两读音栏不合而对音近「餞」，据「蜜餞」（candied fruit）定主义

entries.zh: 泡茶；沏茶（以沸水冲泡茶叶）
entries.en: to steep / brew tea (to infuse tea leaves in boiling water)
entries.notes: 汉栏首字标注泡/疱存疑，L 栏文句疑有讹（techa 或为 echa「投入」之讹）；主义据 M/R 对音与「泡茶」定
